stemMd: With prices swinging sharply from one day to the next, the market was unusually ______.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Sharp frequent changes indicate instability. Volatile and unstable complete the sentence with the same meaning; neither necessarily implies profit or absence of regulation.

distractorRationale.a: This suggests calm rather than sharp swings.
distractorRationale.d: The presence of regulation is not stated.
